mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, signaling economic weakness and reducing corporate earnings prospects, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS above their 3-month moving averages) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%) defines a monetary tightening cycle, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO above its 3-month moving average) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate profits and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%) signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong employment growth (PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.5%) and declining unemployment (UNRATE MoM decline > 0.1pp) indicate a tightening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.5% and UNRATE MoM decline > 0.1pp
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM growth exceeds 0.5% and UNRATE MoM decline exceeds 0.1pp, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1 > 19500) during a late-cycle expansion phase indicates an economy approaching its potential, increasing the risk of a policy-induced slowdown and reducing equity market returns, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 exceeds 19500, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
